why: edits on a stale base create merge debt
a decision must reach every artifact before the gate that checks them is armed, or the gate fires on known-stale state
publish the fully-propagated shape, not a half-cascaded one
a baseline recorded against an unpinned or dead version is worthless
lock the resolved graph before bumping majors, so the bump is reviewable and revertable
establish test signal before an upgrade so breakage is detectable
publish the cleaned shape once; do not publish and then prune
